Name: SmartHand
Description: Control Fingers in a smarter way.

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Control Fingers in a smarter way.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- HandBlock: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Axes: which Smart ctrl rotation does what (Curl, Sides, Spread). Default XSpread_YSides_ZCurl is the old Mode A, XCurl_YSpread_ZSides is the old Mode B. Blocks with the old Mode attr keep working.
- v002: works with Hand v002 Orients = SN (the smart groups stay in the finger frame they had before the orient change).

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
